title: This Week’s MSFS 2024 Marketplace Drop: 747 BA + A320 Brussels Missions!
description:
🔍 Description
In the week of January 29, 2026, Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update brings two must‑have activities for mission lovers — including the iconic British Airways Boeing 747 and the beautifully themed Brussels Trident A320.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 4AIR MISSIONS – B747 British Airways (Long‑haul mission pack for the Queen of the Skies)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: A320 Captain – Brussels Trident (Regional A320 missions featuring the Trident livery)

If you enjoy these breakdowns, don’t forget to hit the like button, subscribe for weekly updates, and drop your thoughts in the comments — I always love hearing what you’re flying!

Thanks for watching and supporting the channel. ✈️ See you in the skies!
